# doorbell433 partition table — THE layo: #     is a SPIFFS image and SPIFFS images are exactly the partition size
#     storage.bin stays valid for EVERY box — including already-deployed ones
#     whose on-flash 16 MB table has its 1 MB storage at 0x420000 and receives
#     the identical image via POST /api/ota/webui.
# The arithmetic (total flash 0x400000):
#     0x1d000 otadata  0x2000    ->  0x1f000
# THE OFFSETS ARE A CONTRACT. OTA never rewrites the partition table
# first flashed with an older table (the 24 KB-NVS one
# its 2 MB slots) keeps that table forever and keeps working: the app image is
# gated to fit the SMALLEST slot any table has
# free space at runtime (signal_store.c) instead of assuming this table.
# Re-flashing the full merged image installs this table and factory-resets; NVS
# starting at the same 0x9000 means the whole 0x9000..0x1d000 window stays
# reserved 0xFF in the merged image (release.yml verifies that).
